title: Pool Fencing quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Install a new pool fence for a residential property in Bondi, NSW. The scope includes: 18 lineal metres of 1200mm high, 12mm thick clear toughened glass pool fencing, comprising twelve 1200mm x 1500mm glass panels. One 900mm wide x 1200mm high self-closing, self-latching tubular steel gate (black powder-coat). Twenty-four stainless steel spigots (square, core drill type). Two 65x65x1800mm powder-coated aluminium gate posts. Two heavy-duty self-closing hinges. One MagnaLatch Top Pull Series 3 gate latch. Twenty-four core holes drilled into existing concrete paving for spigots, two core holes for gate posts. All core holes to be filled with non-shrink grout. Site clearance and waste removal. Provide a compliance certificate for AS1926.1.
workingDetail: Glass panels or aluminium/tubular steel panels, Spigots or posts, Self-closing, self-latching gate, Gate hinges and latch hardware
